Title: Brimstone Under Siege
Description: A troubled woman at the Refugee Caravan has warned of an impending attack by the Corrupted Legion, and has asked for your help to defend the civilians.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" bin="1" bout="2" />When I want something. We’re in desperate need of capable warriors!
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" priority="high" />These people are refugees, not soldiers. They can’t repel an assault by the Corrupted Legion.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> Please stop those vicious murderers!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ha! You’ve done it! My instincts are never wrong!<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> Well, not when it’s important.

Title: The Great Architect
Description: Ghazi Laghmani has asked for any possible assistance in finding her teacher, the Great Sage Imhotep, last seen near The Acropolis.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />The Great Sage of Brimstone! Oldest<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" /> living soul on Aeternum, friend to the Ancients, architect of the Great Pyramid at Akhet!
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />Have you found any sign of the Great Sage Imhotep?<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> We desperately need his wisdom.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />You’ve returned! To be honest, I wasn't sure if you would.<g id="g_litearmor_takeitem5s" priority="high" /> What’s this? A journal page?

Title: Preemptive Strike
Description: Ghazi has received word that the Corrupted Legion is preparing an even larger assault on the Caravan. While she heads north to search for Imhotep, she has asked you to attack the Legion directly at their garrison of Crassus's Rise.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Noticed that, did you? They’re the original Romans who<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> founded New Corsica centuries ago.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />If you thin the ranks at the Legion garrison, that might take the fight out of those vicious brutes.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> And believe me, they have it coming.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I was<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" bin="1" bout="1.5"/> hoping to see your striking visage again! And your aura of<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> confidence has grown. That can only mean victory, yes? Well done!

Title: Stirring in the Sands
Description: Imhotep continues to investigate a new threat, heading west toward Carthago. Once found, Ghazi anxiously awaits news of his return at Cavalier's Rest.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />I’m afraid it’s… complicated. You see, when someone lives as long as Imhotep, their mind can become<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> full and sometimes spill, like a vessel holding too much water.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_clasphandsconvince" />Have you searched Carthago for any signs of Imhotep and Aban? We must find them!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />You’ve returned! By Isis, you're tougher than old crocodile leather.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> But your look is so grim. I’m afraid to ask…

Title: A Blossoming Threat
Description: With the ambush by the Angry Earth, Ghazi is certain they are responsible for Imhotep's disappearance. She knows the Angry Earth have been seen around Jupiter's Grove, and asks again for your continued help in finding Imhotep.\n\nGhazi's scouts have reported that you will need a ranged weapon to complete this task.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />Angry Earth? They must have attacked Imhotep. I’ve never heard of them wandering that far.
InProgressResponse: (Blank Space)
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />You made it! You're becoming as reliable as the dawn!

Title: Past Prologue
Description: While Imhotep recuperates from his recent tribulations, Ghazi has suggested you read Imhotep's 'Legacy of the Ancients' and learn of the impact the Ancients had on Brimstone Sands.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />The Pontifex Charmion, a spiritual leader here for many years.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> She was once very wise, but she’s lost her way.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Have you looked at Imhotep’s scroll? I think you’ll find it illuminating.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_why" />I am NOT BEING LOUD! I'm simply worried about you-<g id="g_litearmor_whatwantfromme" /> think about Aban!

Title: Watering the Seed
Description: Recovered from his kidnapping, the Great Sage Imhotep has told you of the strange seed carried north by the Angry Earth, likely to the Oasis Spontanea. He and Ghazi will await you at the Great Shrine of Thoth.
PlayerPrompt: "You need me to find the Seed."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_youknows" />You see what I said about our friend here?
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />I'll never forget your help in rescuing Imhotep. I’m in your debt.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ah, there you are! No doubt you’ve witnessed all manner of fascinating events and faced innumerable perils.

Title: Unraveling the Mystery
Description: Unable to breach the magic of the Ancient focus, Imhotep knows of a powerful spell which may provide answers. Relics from Aqua Anuket, Arit-en-Geb, and Anhur's Pride should empower his magic enough to succeed.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh, I knew them.<g id="g_male_nod2" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> Well enough to worry about a device like this.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Have you collected the components I need to unlock the Ancient device?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_shocked" />No! It cannot be- we have unleashed the demon!

Title: Accursed Apophis
Description: Apophis's remarks have Imhotep worried about a grander machination involving Ancient technology. He suggests investigating an undisturbed Ancient vault in Hermopolis, where Apophis may have found materials for his plans, while he and Ghazi return to New Corsica.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_male_converseright"  bin="2" bout="2"/>The Ancients awakened the Angry Earth to battle Corruption.<g id="g_female_fingerwagno"  bin="2" bout="2"/> But their deadly weapon perceived us as a threat as well.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Go to Hermopolis and find a way to access the Ancient vault. We must discover Apophis’s plan before it’s too late.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />My mighty Sword returns! You shine with the light of Ra. What<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> mysteries have you uncovered in the vault?<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Speak to your pharaoh!

Title: The Demon's Cauldron
Description: Imhotep's translation speaks of a method to merge two beings together, a practice thought long lost. The sulfurous jar indicates a visit to the Pools of Orcus to the west, and he asks your help in searching for clues to Apophis's plans.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_male_shakehead" />I did not think it possible. But perhaps I was mistaken.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Have you been to the Pools of Orcus? We must know what manner of abomination Apophis is creating.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Is there no task that you cannot accomplish? Ptah has crafted me a very fine weapon indeed.

Title: Power of the Ancients
Description: Imhotep is intimately familiar with the fragment of the Ancient power source, having designed the Pyramid of Akhet to house it. He suggests searching near Diospolis for an entry point to the pyramid's interior, the origin of the fragment.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />When active, it powered the Ancients’ great machines throughout the island.<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" /> Hm. Apophis did boast he had been granted power.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />Find your way into Akhet via the Diospolis entrance. We must know what Apophis intends to do with the Ennead’s power.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_female_explains" />Even here, I sensed the surge of power from Akhet!<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> The earth hums with the energized blood flowing through her veins.

Title: Scourge of Aeon Madness
Description: Adiana's revelation at the pyramid has caused Imhotep's Aeon Madness to assert itself, and Ghazi has asked for help in gathering local herbs needed to treat the Great Sage. She will attempt to calm Imhotep while you prepare the recipe.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />I devised a more potent formula but I’ve run out of the materials to create it.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_why" />Imhotep's mind teeters on the edge! We need the improved elixir to heal him!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Oh great Osiris! Imhotep is gone!

Title: The Eye of Horus
Description: Ghazi's concern at Imhotep's flight is evident, and she begs your assistance in chasing him down. He ran toward the Gates of Sutekh, ranting about the Eye of Horus and the return of the gods.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />He must be headed to the Gates of Sutekh. They lie to the west.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" /> Go to the Gates of Sutekh. Imhotep is there searching for the Eye of Horus. You must find it before he does!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Retrieve the Eye of Horus! Use your staff! Track its potent quintessence!

Title: Challenging the Pharaoh
Description: The Eye of Horus has been taken, but droplets of quintessence form a path to follow. Imhotep, or perhaps something worse, must be at the end of the trail.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_compliment" />You have the code! Excellent! Ghazi’s faith in you is not misplaced.<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> Her instincts are never wrong.

Title: A God Awakens
Description: With the Eye of Horus in hand, Imhotep has given you the location of the Necropolis of Sutekh, the resting place of an Ancient. Adiana and Apophis must not be allowed to rouse Sutekh from his slumber!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_pointthreaten" />That must not happen! You must prevent Sutekh’s return at all costs!
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />You must stop Apophis from awakening Sutekh! An Ancient of his power would wreak havoc on this land!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ah. The Sword of Brimstone returns! You have defeated a mighty demon and brought order to this land.

Title: The Wild Huntress
Description: With the immediate threat stymied and Imhotep stabilized, he has recalled long forgotten memories about a shrine to Artemis somewhere in the northern reaches of Everfall. Visiting it may provide a clue to Adiana's - Artemis's - next move.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_nodding" />I fear that is what the signs do clearly portend. Though Artemis was known to take human form, her hatred for our species was legendary.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_gesturerights" />Have you traveled to the Daughterwell? You may learn more of Artemis’s true intentions.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />You’ve returned! I would guess a confrontation with Artemis did not occur then?

Title: The Missing Praetorians
Description: Captain Andrea Clermont has asked you to find her fellow Praetorians. If they've become Lost, help them find peace and bring back proof of their defeat.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: These Praetorians were to guard the roads so citizens could evacuate the city. We'd received troubling reports of bandits so I was dispatched to check on their status.
InProgressResponse: Those missing Praetorians were my responsibility. I'm ultimately to blame for their fates.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So my suspicions were correct? I prayed it would be otherwise. Those Praetorians were brave soldiers… and good friends.

Title: Personal Demons
Description: Discover if Praetorian Malatesta still lives. If he has become Lost, defeat him and retrieve his insignia
ObjectiveProposalResponse: He had a... regrettable past. I can't speak further without betraying his confidence. What’s important now is that we discover his fate.
InProgressResponse: Please, I must know the fate of Praetorian Malatesta. It's important to me.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: A letter from Emiliano? He was... robbing the evacuating citizens?

Title: Duties Maintained
Description: Take Captain Clermont’s reports back to Prefect Severan in New Corsica.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The roads must be guarded, no matter the circumstances or the cost. That was Praetorian Malatesta’s mission. And now it’s mine.
InProgressResponse: I pray the Prefect is able to find recruits for the Praetorian Guard. We are in desperate need.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Praise Jupiter! Captain Clermont still lives! Her loss would’ve been a great blow to New Corsica.

Title: Roar of the Manticore
Description: Inside the Acropolis, investigate the threats that plague the trade route.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: This caravan was due to deliver vital supplies from New Corsica to the outpost near The Acropolis.
InProgressResponse: Have you had a change of heart? I can't blame you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Jupiter's balls! Look at the size of that stinger! Oh, see! I told you he was telling the truth! Tell me, what did the beast look like?

Title: Audience with the Pontifex
Description: Prelate Razin has blocked you from speaking with Pontifex Charmion until you have gained an understanding of the True Gods, and the threat posed the Legion. Read the ‘Legacy of Rome’, then speak with the Prelate again.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It will reveal the truth of what afflicts this land. It must be made known to all who enter here.
InProgressResponse: You must meditate on the Sacred Scroll of Awakening if you wish to speak to Pontifex Charmion.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The Light of Truth has blessed you! Now, speak to the Pontifex. You will benefit from her wisdom.

Title: Power of the Gods
Description: Pontifex Charmion has requested that you seek out Pontiff Nuru in the Cradle of Nu and offer her aid.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: General Crassus, curse his name! Once trusted with our defense and considered a hero, he and his legionaries now ravage the land as bloodthirsty Corrupted!
InProgressResponse: Have you aided Nuru? The gods whisper to me of your great destiny here.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The Pontifex sent you? Oh, praise the gods! I cannot possibly accomplish this task on my own.

Title: The Sleeping Vessels
Description: Search the wreckage for materials to craft Pontiff Nuru’s relic.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Some in this land call the gods the Ancients. The people of New Corsica call them the Blessed Nine.
InProgressResponse: Have you found the materials for the holy relic? Without them, I cannot awaken these sacred vessels.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Yes, this is precisely what I need. Now, let me see… the design must be strictly followed…

Title: Gems of the Immortals
Description: Pontiff Nuru has asked you to defeat Anubian Automata and Constructs, and collect the gems they possess.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It’s not finished. It requires gems to channel the gods' divine power. The idols possess such gems as eyes.
InProgressResponse: Those gems should be the final pieces I require. New Corsica depends upon our success!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have the gems! Wonderful! Now I must arrange them in a pattern pleasing to the gods. Yes, that seems right…

Title: Awakening Anubis
Description: Pontiff Nuru has asked you to use the holy relic at the sarcophagus to awaken the Hand of Anubis.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Place it carefully on the sarcophagus. It will awaken the vessel slumbering within and place it under your control.
InProgressResponse: I am praying for the gods to protect you when you use the relic.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It awoke and went berserk? Oh gods, no! I followed the Pontifex’s instruction to the letter! My prayer must have been insufficient.

Title: Insufficient Faith
Description: Report Pontiff Nuru’s failure to awaken the Anubian vessels to Pontifex Charmion.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: No, there is no other explanation. The gods are blameless so the fault must lie with me. The Pontifex will not be pleased…
InProgressResponse: I am ready to receive the Pontifex’s judgement.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Nuru failed?! That is a great disappointment and it will cost New Corsica dearly.

Title: Cursed Across Centuries
Description: Speak with Ariel Gideon about the plan to fight the 19th Legion, then find Tribune Kraus on the Scorched Battlefield.
PlayerPrompt: “Is that why the city is barren?”
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, most of our citizens have fled. A brave few volunteered to fight against Crassus.
InProgressResponse: If you truly wish to help New Corsica, seek Tribune Kraus on the Scorched Battlefield.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Reinforcements? Thank the stars! I had almost given up hope.

Title: Assault Against the Legion
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to defeat 19th Legion troops in their war camps.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They seem to be preparing a strike against New Corsica, but I can’t be sure. There’s too many of them and I can’t get a closer look.
InProgressResponse: We must thin out the 19th Legion’s numbers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That was most impressive! While you were engaging those legionaries, I managed to get a closer look.

Title: The Hydra's Breath
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to steal Hydra’s Breath from the 19th Legion to help destroy the enemy's siege weapons.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They’re Crassus’s army, formed by Mark Antony in Egypt during Cleopatra’s rebellion.
InProgressResponse: Without casks of Hydra’s Breath, we have no chance of destroying those siege engines.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Excellent work! With the power of Hydra’s Breath in our possession, we now have a fighting chance.

Title: A Blaze of Glory
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to destroy the 19th Legion's artillery and defeat Primus Vespasian.
PlayerPrompt: “I found this vial and a scroll.”
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Hmm, I’ve never seen anything like the substance in this vial. It’s very strange. The scroll is written in Greek. It’s a formula for something.
InProgressResponse: If Ignatius’s words are true, our time is short. You must destroy the artillery.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, what a victory! New Corsica shall be spared destruction by fire. We are in your debt.

Title: The Last True Centurion
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to find and restore the New Corsican hero Evandrus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: He is Crassus’s son! Turned to stone all those centuries ago. His petrified body rests at the Legion’s old fort.
InProgressResponse: Restore Evandrus! He is the ally we need!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Uhhh… my vision swims with shadows… am I still dreaming…? What has happened?

Title: A Legend Restored
Description: Inform the newly awakened Evandrus of the current invasion then report back to Tribune Kraus.
PlayerPrompt: “You were stone for a long time.”
ObjectiveProposalResponse: How? Were we attacked? I recall my father was marching to Akhet. He left me and a small garrison to guard the fort.
InProgressResponse: I shall return to New Corsica as soon as my head has cleared. There is so much to consider…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Evandrus has been restored? Praise be! Our fortunes are certain to change! Where is he? What does he intend to do?

Title: A Hero No More
Description: Inform Evandrus that Charmion commands him to return to New Corsica.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Deceiver! I believed you to be sent by the gods! Now I see you for who you truly are!
InProgressResponse: Atone for your sins! Find Evandrus and deal with him!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It is good to see a familiar face! What news do you bring?

Title: Ultimate Intentions
Description: Evandrus has asked that you infiltrate the Corrupted Legion camp and steal their communications.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The power of that insidious sickness is unknown to me. Charmion insists it was my father's blasphemous pact that freed the Legion.
InProgressResponse: The sooner we can get those deployment reports, the sooner we can formulate our plan.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have the reports! Excellent! Hmm, it seems someone has made an impression on them. I take it that was you?

Title: Strength and Weakness
Description: Destroy the 19th Legion's supplies and slay Centurion Magnus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I never did like that brute. I’d be happy to have him sent to the Underworld.
InProgressResponse: Give my regards to that brute Magnus, would you?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: By the helm of Mars! I can hear the chaos you've unleashed on the camp from here!

Title: One Tribune at a Time
Description: In order to weaken Drusilla, you must take out her tribunes, one by one.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Mark Antony made her a tribune because he needed commanders against Octavian in Egypt. Drusilla’s ruthless tactics seemingly impressed him.
InProgressResponse: Eliminating five highly trained tribunes would be too great a task for most, but I feel you are different.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Five Tribunes of the 19th Legion felled in battle! Even the mighty Achilles would be impressed!

Title: Head of the Snake
Description: Destroy the Legion’s command tents and defeat Prefect Drusilla.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, I cannot deny that, though I wish it were not so.
InProgressResponse: Drusilla's shade is long overdue in the Underworld. Send her on her way.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: By Jupiter, you’ve done it! Drusilla’s defeat has already begun to scatter the Legion’s forces. In salute of you, noble hero!

Title: Sic Transit Gloria Mundi
Description: Return to Charmion with news of your success against Drusilla's forces.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I am grateful, my friend. I must think only of my duty to New Corsica. Her safety is all that matters now.
InProgressResponse: Inform Charmion that Drusilla and her centurions have been defeated.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You allowed Evandrus to live? Your victory against Drusilla proves nothing!

Title: Secrets in the Sands
Description: Speak to Pontiff Nuru at the Valley of the Gods and help her uncover the secrets of the Ennead.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Severan warned me that her mind was slipping. I will have to ask him to have her watched.
InProgressResponse: What has Pontiff Nuru discovered at the Valley of the Gods? Her findings may be our salvation.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My relic-builder! It’s so good to see you again!

Title: Miracles and Madness
Description: Recover Charmion’s journal and the Great Ennead Codex to reveal the secrets of Akhet.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: She possesses such knowledge. She was once Cleopatra’s handmaiden, a priestess of Egypt.
InProgressResponse: Did you find the journal and the Codex tablets? We must learn what we can about Akhet.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You’ve found the Codex! And the Pontifex’s journal as well! Praise the gods! Whatever they may actually be…

Title: Hieratic Truth
Description: You must gather pieces of the Prime Key.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh, gods... Crassus did not release Medusa’s Curse. It was the Pontifex!
InProgressResponse: Have you recovered the pieces of the Prime Key? We may not have much time left.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You recovered the pieces! Praise the Blessed Nine! Sorry, force of habit…

Title: The Key that was Broken
Description: Destroy the Lore Keeper and reforge the Prime Key.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, but we were using an Egyptian text to try and control powers on Aeternum.
InProgressResponse: Did you reforge the Prime Key? I can’t wait to see what it looks like.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You’re alive! Thank the gods! And you’ve reforged the Prime Key!

Title: Circles in Time
Description: Report what you have discovered about Akhet and the reforged Prime Key to Evandrus.
PlayerPrompt: "How do we use the Prime Key?”
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Codex mentions glyphs in the Forge of Ptah that speak of the Key’s function.
InProgressResponse: Tell Evandrus what we’ve done. Tell him there is hope for New Corsica!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The hero of New Corsica returns! And bearing gifts! What is that strange device?

Title: The Mighty Must Fall (Expedition)
Description: Evandrus has asked you to go to the Ennead and confront his father General Crassus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I was hoping that terrible plague could be resisted by someone with a noble heart and a strong mind.
InProgressResponse: Release my father from his torment, I beg you. His threat to New Corsica must be ended.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hail, hero of New Corsica! The people have named me their new Legatus.

Title: The Final Seal (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Pyramid of Akhet and seal the Ennead with the Prime Key to protect the people of Aeternum.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Thank you! Charmion was wrong. The Ennead is not a gate to be opened. It must be sealed.
InProgressResponse: You must insert the Prime Key into the Ennead. Its power is too dangerous to leave uncontained.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That beam of celestial light is the most beautiful thing I’ve ever seen! Could this have been how the builders of Akhet spoke with their gods?

Title: Secret in the Desert
Description: With Apophis no longer a threat, Imhotep has turned his attention to matters closer to home. He has asked assistance in recovering a precious and mysterious parcel, buried long ago.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />There is a parcel I wish recovered. You may find it buried to the south,<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> near a place sacred to Sobek.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_leanforwardinspect" />Have you acquired my parcel? It contains something of great value to<g id="g_male_converseleft" /> all of Brimstone. Please retrieve it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_female_takeitem5s" priority="high" />Ah, our precious parcel. Thank you. I knew we would need this someday.

Title: A Queen Revealed
Description: Ghazi's true identity has been revealed - Cleopatra VII Thea Philopater, Queen of Egypt! Her return would bring hope to the people of New Corsica, but Evandrus may have other ideas. Speak with him to determine his feelings.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_gestureforward02" />Yes, our dear Ghazi is indeed Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Have you spoken to Evandrus about Queen Cleopatra’s return?<g id="g_female_explains" /> His opinion is vital to swaying Ghazi.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Have you spoken with Evandrus? What did he say?<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> Do not spare my feelings. Well, maybe spare them<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> just a little…

Title: The Coronation
Description: With Evandrus's support, Cleopatra has consented to retake her position of power. Inform all of New Corsica of her return, then attend her coronation at the Royal Pavilion.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />It’s not the challenge that worries me. I’ve faced<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> many perils in the service of Imhotep, as you have seen.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_leanforwardsmall" />Have you spoken to the people? I<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> must know how they feel about my potential return.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well, that’s done. Now the real work begins for us.

Title: Tremors in the Sand
Description: One of Imhotep's allies, Lysandra, has sent warning of strange events in the sands. Imhotep has asked you to seek her out and assist her in determining their cause.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: By Ra's Light, let's hope not! I was hoping you could investigate.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_youknow" />Have you spoken to Lysandra about those strange tremors in the desert?<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" /> We need to know what is causing them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You found spines? Good gods... I will study these and see what I can glean.

Title: The Ancient Glyphs
Description: William Heron seeks an intrepid adventurer to search for Ancient Glyphs. Collect the glyph at the ruins of Satet, discover its purpose, and return to Heron in New Corsica.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ha ha! Around here, one could blindly throw a stone and hit something interesting.
InProgressResponse: Trust me, you'll understand the… oddities of Ancient glyphs better if you find one yourself.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well? A fascinating experience, wasn't it? Knowing the meaning of the glyph acted as a key for you.

Title: Scarab Secrets
Description: Eudoxia Dalassema needs someone willing to crack open Anubian Scarab Constructs and mine out the power sources within--preferably without alerting the authorities in New Corsica.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Then I have your attention? Excellent.
InProgressResponse: The constructs cluster near Khnum, though I've never understood why. The ruin's naught but crumbling walls. Are they guarding something?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh, these devices look like toys! Can something this small give life to an entire construct?

Title: Lone Jackal
Description: Slay the jackals of Deadwater Den who attacked Senhyris, and find some medicine to treat her wounds.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Do I look all right to you? Between the desert and the beasts, I'm lucky I'm even breathing.
InProgressResponse: Did you lose your nerve? Or maybe you thought better of chasing after jackals.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is that medicine? You didn't have to do that. Thank you. For driving off the jackals, and saving my sorry skin.

Title: Ruffled Feathers
Description: Nesse van Baten wants revenge on "Featherbane" the lion, who has developed an unfortunate taste for domestic poultry. Go to Two-Stones Grotto, then meet back up with Nesse at the nearby Outpost.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Help? Hah! That would be a first in this godforsaken wasteland.
InProgressResponse: I didn't name the lion "Featherbane." One of the other refugees thought it was funny.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Featherbane is gone? That's the first good news I've heard in weeks!

Title: Aggressive Negotiations
Description: Huang Xiaoling is looking for a man who may have shipwrecked on the southern coast of Brimstone Sands. Search for any survivors at The Offering, then meet up with Xiaoling at Cavalier's Rest.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, I watched from safety. What was I to do, wade out into the waves and battle them myself?
InProgressResponse: What possessed the Ambassador to keep sailing through such a terrible storm?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It's you. And since you are unscathed and uncorrupted, I assume you found Ambassador Li? Or he did not make it ashore?

Title: Broken Pedestals
Description: Froderico Renaldi is beside himself after being murdered just outside Castrum Inferos. Recover the unfortunate historian's belongings from the Castrum, and return them to him.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I sent a letter to their camp, announcing my intentions to survey their buildings for posterity.
InProgressResponse: If Caesar, Augustus, and Antony could see how far their Roman brethren had fallen… Would they weep at this degeneracy?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My notes! Grazie mille, friend. That's my life's work… though it may need some revision.

Title: An Ancient Balancing Act
Description: Perrin Mercier discovered a tantalizing mystery in the collapsed Roman aqueduct, but can't climb it himself. Brave the treacherous ascent into the aqueduct, then return to Perrin with your findings.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ah. Mostly my ego bruised. Have you read the writings of William Heron? His words inspired me to be an antiquarian.
InProgressResponse: Be careful, friend. I thought the aqueduct looked easy to climb, and I paid for my hubris.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You really did it? Climbed the aqueduct and came back in one piece? The last mercenary who passed through just scoffed at me.

Title: Coming Forth by Day
Description: Acolyte Miresis seeks Egyptian funerary rites from his former mentor Psherenamun, who has become Lost. Seek out Psherenamun at Castrum Perdita, take the texts from him, and return to Saboteur's Hideaway.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Before we came to Aeternum, my people performed nearly two hundred incantations for the dead. But the practice faded long ago.
InProgressResponse: Where did we go wrong? Was it the incantations? The images? The mystical names of the judges?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You return! And you seem sound of mind and body. But what of Psherenamun? Was he still…?

Title: The Insatiable Flame
Description: Bring delicious fish to the Insatiable Flame before he decides to make a snack out of you. You can catch fresh fish from any fishing hotspot in Brimstone Sands.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: And I'd rather not go hungry! So what do you mean to do about it, human?
InProgressResponse: Fish? No? Then begone.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Mrr, the delectable aroma of fish. This is much better than eating you.

Title: Artistic License
Description: Enez de Barros is convinced that there are dragon eggs at the Palace of Nekhbet. Search the reptile nests for eggs of any sort, and bring them back for Enez's inspection.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That's a shame. As a little girl, I loved stories of dragons, and I was hoping to find some for creative inspiration.
InProgressResponse: My father used to read me the story of Saint George, and I always felt sorry for the dragon.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hmm, just by looking at your face, I can see there were no dragons awaiting you. Ah, well. Perhaps they hide elsewhere on Aeternum.

Title: Path of the Devourer
Description: Lysandra is distressed by strange tremors that have recently rocked the Great Pyramid of Akhet. Survey the area around the pyramid's base, and find evidence of what is causing the tremors.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: See the pyramid? Quiet for eons, but tremors started beneath its base a few weeks ago.
InProgressResponse: If you see something bigger than you, run. If it's bigger and faster, hide.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Don't take this the wrong way, friend, but you look like you've seen terrible things. I'm not going to like what you found, am I?

Title: The Antiquarian's Dream
Description: Emboldened by your success at the aqueduct, Perrin seeks your help to unlock the function of an Ancient stone gateway. Look for clues in the ruins of Hermopolis, then return to Perrin at the Great Shrine of Thoth.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That could be. I've never had the chance to compare the different gateways.
InProgressResponse: Oh please, let me know as soon as you've visited Hermopolis.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You… what did you do? How did you accomplish that?! I found the very same glyph, but I never produced even a flicker of magic!

Title: The Queen's Brood (Elite)
Description: The naturalist Tamouthis is concerned by the sudden and unnatural proliferation of massive scorpions in the Bubasteum. Venture into the Beds of Ta-Bitjet and slay the scorpion queen who lives there.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You're cautious. Good to see that fame and glory haven't gone to your head.
InProgressResponse: Hmm… I don't know what's behind the brood's unnatural behavior, but for now, exterminating them is all that matters.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I can smell the scorpion ichor from here. Was it a good hunt? Did you learn why these scorpions were so ferocious?

Title: Secrets of the Heartgem
Description: <font color="#b2aea1">HEARTRUNE UNLOCK QUEST</font>\nThe Soulwardens sent Anna Rózsa to learn about an intriguing source of power in Brimstone Sands. Unlock your Heartgem's hidden potential at the Great Wall of Nebet-Het, then meet Scout Rózsa at the Palace of Nekhbet.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You may have heard the rumors, but a Soulwarden's Heartgem can grant additional powers through the etching of specific runes.
InProgressResponse: Sorry I couldn't tell you more about the Wall. You'll know it when you see it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're back! What a relief. I wouldn't know what to say to the other Soulwardens if something happened to our hero.

Title: The Gods' Demand
Description: The priest Paubastis needs you to venture near the temple ruins of Henkhisesui, slay a lion, and bring back its heart. He promises good payment but refuses to explain why.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: A reasonable answer. You know that this land has faced harsh trials lately.
InProgressResponse: Surely someone like you is accustomed to slaying large wildlife?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're back with the heart? I have some coin for you. Our business is concluded, and you can be on your way.

Title: Flower of the Sands
Description: Collect Cactus Flowers in memory of Zahur's husband and bring them to him in the Camp.
PlayerPrompt: "What is it you can't leave behind?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The memories... of my love. Titus and I were friends for decades, but then it blossomed into something more.
InProgressResponse: My sweet Titus. I will not leave with nothing to remember him by.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, you found them. Just as bright and beautiful as the day my Titus came in from the sands.

Title: Sand Walkers
Description: Defeat the Sand Walkers in The Acropolis for Tahirah.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The sands…. they come to life and walk on two feet! Just like you and me! It is most unnatural!
InProgressResponse: These Sand Walkers… they mean to replace us. I swear it. You must strike them down!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have returned the Walkers to the sands! Heroes like you saved us once before.

Title: Honoring the 19th
Description: Confiscate Pickaxes from the Corrupted 19th, and recover their Legion Insignias for Acario Clemon.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It is a dark tale I do not care to dwell upon. In recent years, some of us have taken up the banner to restore the Legion's honor.
InProgressResponse: We will restore honor to the crest of the 19th Legion, no matter how long it takes.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I heard the clamor. It sounded like you dealt those villains a blow that'll shut them down! Well done!

Title: On Duty, the Sun Never Sets
Description: Once Priestess of the Lamp of Osiris, Qabalah asks you to destroy the Ancient Guardians that contol the temple and retrieve the sacred Spark of Osiris from the Lamplighter. The Lamplighter ascends the ruins at day, but descends into a hidden chamber at night.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Ancient Anubians, servant-constructs to the Ancients themselves. They prevent humans from trespassing.
InProgressResponse: The Lamplighter appears above at day, but cycles into the bowels of the temple at night. There is a way, but it is not easily seen.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I have not seen anyone challenge the Anubians as you have in many a moon. Indeed, the spirit of the heroes of old lives on in you.

Title: The Secret of the Baths
Description: Thermae Alchemist Clarisse Vesta has asked you to collect Embalming Sands from the sarcophagi in Jupiter's Grove for the Roman baths in New Corsica. Deliver them to Host Habibah in the city.
PlayerPrompt: "Is there anything I can help with?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Perhaps, if you have the capacity to exercise a certain level of discretion.
InProgressResponse: The thermae in New Corsica will soon turn foul without these sands. Please hurry!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Welcome to the Thermae of New Corsica, traveler, the finest in all Aeternum.

Title: Honor's End
Description: A Roman is searching for memoriabelia of his departed friends.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I was once courier to the lord Crassus and his legion. He dispatched me to seek reinforcements during his battle to secure this once-sacred place.
InProgressResponse: I implore you, stranger… help me perform this last act of service.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My thanks, friend. Over time, hope rots and poisons the heart. At least this way, the loved ones of our fallen can have closure.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: I am grateful for you help, friend. I will return these coins to their families. Afterwards I may yet have further need of you.
